title: Runtime Player Control Channel worked exchange examples (C4 §3/§8)
description: Pure-JSON message sequences the soul zone reads to learn the wire contract. `direction` is serverToClient (器 -> 魂) or clientToServer (魂 -> 器). The happy path is connect -> server.hello -> intent.set -> accepted; each rejection code has one rejected example. The 器 keeps the connection open for every rejection (C4 §3.5).

happyPath.description: Connect, receive capabilities, set one intent, get accepted.

messages.note: Sent immediately on connect (C4 §3.4). C5 additively advertises intent.envelope; C6 additively advertises intent.speech; the voice swap additively advertises intent.speechStream, alongside intent.set.
Turn the head via the head-horizontal slot for 800ms.
ttlMs omitted -> the 器's default window applies (streaming style).

envelopePath.description: C5 intent.envelope worked exchange (additive over intent.set). The soul sends one envelope intent (peak + attack/sustain/decay) and the 器 draws the curve at 60Hz; the reply is accepted, correlated by replyTo. The intent.set path above is unchanged.

messages.note: Rise head-horizontal to 0.8 over 120ms, hold 600ms, decay 400ms — the 器 draws the curve, the soul sends once.

speechPath.description: C6 intent.speech worked exchange (additive over intent.set/intent.envelope). The soul sends ONE variable-length mora列 and the 器's group evaluator plays it back — the mouth speaks 「これじっさいのところどうなってるの」 (fixture phrase, 設計 §7 裁定7: all five vowels + a same-vowel run 「のところど」= o×5, the re-articulation-dip 試金石). No slotId on the wire — vowel labels map to the fixed mouth group. No attack field — attack ≈ the mora interval, derived by the 器. The reply is accepted, correlated by replyTo. The intent.set/intent.envelope paths above are unchanged.

messages.note: Speak 「これじっさいのところどうなってるの」. 15 moras (促音「っ」dropped): o,e,i,a,i, o,o,o,o,o, u,a,e,u,o. timeMs monotonically increasing (~110-130ms beats); s = pre-scale opening strength 0.5..0.9 (the 器 applies its universal 0.8 scale + re-articulation dip).

speechStreamPath.description: Voice swap intent.speechStream worked exchange (additive over intent.speech). The soul opens one utterance, appends the mouth timeline in slices while the voice is still being synthesized, then ends it. t=0 is the acceptance instant of the open; every timeMs is relative to it and strictly increasing across appends. Until end the 器 holds the last vowel when the data runs out; after end the usual terminal (hold the last interval, then release over 400ms) applies. The stale append after a newer open is accepted and ignored (an old utterance's tail). Every reply is accepted, correlated by replyTo. The intent.speech path above is unchanged (the 器 runs it as open + append + end internally).

messages.note: Open utterance u-1. Its acceptance instant becomes t=0.
First slice of 「これじっさい」: o,e,i,a,i.
Next slice 「のところ」: continues after 510ms (strictly increasing within the utterance).
No more moras for u-1: the mouth now closes after the last mora (hold the last interval, then release).
Open the next utterance u-2 (replaces u-1).
A late append for the replaced u-1: accepted and ignored (u-2 is unaffected).

rejections.note: Unknown kind is rejected; the connection is KEPT (C4 §3.5).
value is not a finite number.
slotId is not part of the semantic-slot vocabulary.
head-horizontal is a centered slot (-1..1); 1.5 is out of range and is NOT clamped.

error.message: value 1.5 is outside the -1..1 range for slot head-horizontal.
